# abcd-banlist: keyed
# Fixture banlist — a keyed store carrying one of every UNUSABLE line class, so
# both readers can be shown to refuse the SAME line numbers without echoing any
# line content. Values are reserved-documentation or persona-derived only.
#
# Line 11 is indented with U+00A0 (a non-breaking space) and line 12 separates
# its fields with U+000B (a vertical tab): neither is an ASCII space or tab, so
# neither line parses as an entry, and both readers must say so identically.
